about: v10: as v9b, the Yamaha upright's treble mended (render_samples.treble_mended): its samples carry the hammer's and the board's knock, 300-900 Hz, under the note; in the C6 sample's first take (a very quiet recording the SFZ raises 40 dB, played by every other B5-D#6 struck: the last verse's tune, an octave up) as loud as the note's own pitch in its first 50 ms, 9 dB under it in the second take, 11-14 dB in the samples around. Now every B5-D#6 plays the second take (swap_samples), and from the G5 sample up (E5 on) each note is high-passed at 0.8 of its own pitch, four-pole (treble_filter): the knock 11-15 dB lower against the note, the note itself 0.7 dB.
